timing: after the first full calibration score was observed

observed_bug.cause: OpenJTalk analyzes the connective て in やってない as a verb with lemma てる. The polarity scan stopped at that token before reaching the following ない auxiliary.
observed_bug.effect: lemma_polarity introduced one critical false positive and was excluded before the advance gates could be evaluated.

amendment.change: While scanning the immediate inflection chain, treat surface て with lemma てる as a grammatical connector and continue to the following token; still stop at every other new content token.

evidence_boundary: Because this correction was chosen after observing the calibration result, the corrected V32 result remains developmental and can authorize only the already-declared fresh source-separated verifier holdout. It cannot authorize runtime integration.
